title: Command Block Delay
description: Adds a delay to command blocks!
body:
This mod adds a delay to Command Blocks, exactly like in Bedrock Edition!

It adds a new box beneath the Command Console to allow to input a delay to when the command runs. There is also a button to make it execute on the first tick, but only for Repeat Command Blocks.



NOTE: Currently does not appear on the UI if mods that change the Command Block's UI are present. (Can still run fine)

Planned:
- Compatibility with [Better Command Block UI](https://modrinth.com/mod/bettercommandblockui) (possibly also [Command Block IDE](https://modrinth.com/mod/command-block-ide))
- Option to still run if not powered after being pulsed by power such as redstone
- Hover Note (possibly would be a different mod)
